newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Harris Scarfe Q3 sales up 13 percent.
newsitem.headline: Harris Scarfe Q3 sales up 13 percent.

text.p: Retailer Harris Scarfe Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday that its sales for the three months to May 4 were up 13 percent to A$50.92 million and were slightly ahead of internal targets.
The company cited a good Easter season and a solid start to the winter season as reasons for the rise.

"The Easter trading period was particularly good for the company with the winter season commencing extremely well," managing director Ron Baker said in a statement, adding that the firm was on target to meet its planned full year numbers.
"If this trend continues the company is confident of achieving its budgeted sales and profits for the year."

In addition to stores opened in Western Australia in the last six months, Baker said the company was committed to opening three new stores in Victoria as well as a new store in South Australia. These stores were expected to be opened in September.
Harris Scarfe shares closed two cents lower at A$1.41 in thin trade of 58,000 shares.
